text:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: spike in 5xx responses for model-serving runtime in us-east-1. Error rate >= 15% over last 2m. Affected route: /v1/generate (redwood-alpha-30b-fp16). Paging oncall.

maria: ugh, I'm seeing the same on dashboards. latency also climbing. routing errors are 502/503/504.

aj (oncall): I'm up, taking this. can someone paste a cluster list?

sanjay: pulling logs now. initial clue: multiple worker pods showing segfaults and kernel panic logs from runtime.

maria: copy. logs attached below (trimmed):

```
2026-03-15T14:12:05Z model-runner[pid=4213] ERROR Segmentation fault at 0x7fff...
2026-03-15T14:12:06Z kernel-manager WARN falling back to legacy-kernel
2026-03-15T14:12:06Z proxy 502 Upstream closed connection during headers
2026-03-15T14:12:09Z model-runner[pid=4230] ERROR OutOfMemoryError: attempted alloc 3.2GB
```

elena: that pattern looks like intermittent OOMs + segfaults at similar sequence lengths. Could be kv-cache growth + a regression in the recent kernel allocator.

aj (oncall): immediate mitigation options?

maria: we can: 1) route traffic away from affected runtime (roll to fallback model variant), 2) scale the node pool (but might just surface more crashes), 3) roll runtime to previous stable image.

ops-bot: deploy 2187654300 started by ci/cd for canary rollback -> runtime-image:v2.14.1

aj (oncall): good. step 1: add a routing policy to divert 100% of /v1/generate to redwood-alpha-30b-q8 in us-east-1 to restore availability. ops, please apply.

maria: applying quick route update now (live patch):

```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/v1/routing/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"us-east-1","route":"/v1/generate","target":"redwood-alpha-30b-q8","weight":100}'
```

maria: route update submitted, control-plane reported success.

support-bot: status page updated: "Degraded performance / increased errors for text generation in US-East. Routing to fallback models in progress."

customer-success: pinging top impacted customers and asking legal to queue incident comms.

aj (oncall): step 2: drain affected model-runner pods to let scheduler recreate them on nodes with different kernel. Running:

```
kubectl -n runtime cordon node/gpu-12
kubectl -n runtime drain node/gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

sanjay: doing cordon+drain across the 3 nodes showing highest crash counts. also increasing logging to capture allocation sizes.

elena: started a quick smoke test on q8 fallback — outputs look intact so far, latency slightly higher but acceptable.

aj (oncall): customer impact note: approx 18% of requests in US-East failed intermittently for ~12 minutes before routing change; some customers saw degraded responses. set incident severity to SEV2 for now.

maria: we should also pin model-runner runtime to v2.14.1 in us-east-1 while we investigate kernel allocator regression. ops can we rollout the rollback image cluster-wide in the region?

ops-bot: rollback to runtime-image:v2.14.1 initiated for us-east-1 (rolling update).

sanjay: after drains+rollback, crash rate dropped to <1% within 4 minutes. returning 200s from control-plane.

aj (oncall): great. I'll update the incident timeline and handoff to eng-ml to do root cause. @elena you'll lead postmortem?

elena: yes. initial hypothesis: new kernel selection changes in v2.15.0 cause a memory accounting corner-case with long prefix KV caching. we'll prioritize a reproduce + minimal repro case.

maria: action items for follow-up (captured):
- eng-ml (elena): reproduce OOM/segfault locally and identify offending kernel path.
- infra (sanjay): collect full core dumps from the affected nodes and secure to bucket (retention high).
- ops: evaluate canary gating and add preflight OOM tests for runtime images.
- support/customer-success: send customer update with timeline and mitigation steps.

support-bot: customer update draft ready, sending to cs-team slack for review.

aj (oncall): I'll stay on for 30m during rollback verification and then hand off to oncall-rotation. if anything spikes, re-alert. thanks all. :v:

incident-bot: NOTE: incident 2187654321 status -> mitigated. root cause assignment: eng-ml/elena. next update in postmortem.

maria: logging final note for timeline. closing thread now but tagging for follow-up meetings.

elena: ack, will schedule RCA and include reproducer and patch plan.

aj (oncall): handing off to next oncall — @sanjay you'll be the responder for follow-up checks.

sanjay: ack. I'll keep watch and upload cores to s3://redwood-incidents/2187654321/cores.tar.gz

maria: thanks team.
